## Project Anchor
- Project: local-llm-visual-benchmark
- Branch: feature/control-center-app
- Goal: local-first visual benchmark viewer with file-backed prompts/runs, dev-only write actions, media-based display, and static publish support.
- Current phase: implementation complete; user asked to commit changes and save context.

## Key Product Contract
- Display behavior is the same in local server mode and published static mode:
  - grid cards show `preview.png`
  - detail modal shows captured video (`preview.mp4` preferred, `preview.webm` fallback)
  - if video is missing, UI explicitly says video has not been captured yet
- Generated `index.html` is source input for local capture only. It is not displayed in the viewer.
- No live iframe preview, no `Open HTML`, no raw response links, and no silent fallback from video to HTML.
- Server mode provides operations only: prepare/delete runs, capture media, LM Studio/model sync, local media serving.
- Published mode is read-only: exported manifest + media only. It does not export or serve `index.html`/raw responses.

## Sunset Ocean Video Debug
- User reported Sunset Ocean video was black.
- Diagnosis:
  - existing `preview.png` was non-black
  - existing `preview.webm`/`preview.mp4` frames were all black and tiny (~13-15 KB)
  - fresh Playwright screenshot and fresh recording from same `index.html` were non-black
  - root cause in generated HTML: animation loop returned before scheduling another RAF if initial timestamp was `<16ms`, making black canvas possible depending on timing
- Fixed current local run by regenerating:
  - `runs/sunset-ocean-study/google-gemma-4-e4b-bae096a7fc/2026-05-08T08-31-35-237Z/preview.webm`
  - `.../preview.mp4`
  - updated its `metadata.json`
- Added guardrail: capture now samples output video and fails/deletes it if frames are basically all black.
